ceu: ✦ The opposition between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between friendships and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your career and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between intimacy and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between relationships and your image. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between routine and your inner life. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between romance and friendships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between family and your career. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between money and intimacy. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your image and relationships. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The opposition between Venus and Jupiter creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.
